title: Form 1: DS&AI Program of Examinations
description: This form is used to create a report that shows your current study program. Its purpose is to be shared with the examination committee, so that they can check whether it satisfies the requirements of DS&AI programs and approve it or inform you of how it does not satisfy the requirements. This form has built-in validation that should help you create a valid study program.

elements.name: homologation_panel
elements.title: Homologation courses
elements.description: Homologation courses are bachelor courses assigned during the admission process to make up deficiencies in previous knowledge. Please check your admission letter to see if you have homologation courses. It is also possible to pick a maximum of three bachelor courses yourself to compensate deficiencies, if you think it is necessary. If you do that, a motivation for including the self-chosen homologation courses must be attached to this form.

You must choose at least one project course!

Your study program must include at least one project course. Below, we show the possible project courses. Select one of them above as a core elective or specialization elective.

  • 2AMV10 Visual Analytics
  • 2AMI30 Process Intelligence in Action
  • 2AMC15 Reinforcement Learning in Practice
  • 2AMD20 Knowledge Engineering

elements.name: internship
elements.title: Do you do an internship as part of your study program?
elements.description: An internship is optional (course code 2IMC10, counts for 15 EC). Keep in mind, when you do an external internship (e.g. at a company), your graduation project needs to be executed internally (within TU/e), when you do an internal internship you cannot graduate with the same supervisor.

elements.name: internship_supervisor
elements.title: Internship supervisor
elements.description: If known, please fill in the name of your TU/e internship supervisor

elements.name: free
elements.title: Which free elective courses did you include?
elements.description:
Free elective courses can be any master-level courses from the TU/e or another university. You can have up to three free elective courses in your study program. In case a free elective was followed at another university, please add its name between parentheses to the course name.

Notes: Homologation courses are considered to fill up a free elective slot, so you need to subtract the number of  homologation courses from the number of courses you need to fill in here. Furthermore, if you do an internship as part of your study program, that completely fills up your free elective space and then you should not fill in anything here.
